critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck primitive along the longitudinal axis of the fuselage. Increase its length from the current position (ending immediately behind the cockpit) to a value that is 150% of the distance between the cockpit and the wing root. Simultaneously, increase the width/radius of this cylinder by 20% to ensure it blends into the main body profile rather than appearing as a narrow cylinder.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is roughly equal in height to the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump sits as a distinct elevated section above the primary fuselage line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, abrupt transition from the nose to the top of the hump.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, aerodynamic curve blending the cockpit into the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears as a narrow cylinder on top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wide, integrated profile that blends into the main body.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width/radius of the upper-deck primitive
